# SmartStudy AI Instructions

- Use React with functional components.
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for styling.
- Keep the UI responsive, modern, and professional.
- Prefer reusable components for each landing page section.
- Keep animations subtle and use Framer Motion for entrance and hover effects.
- Maintain the dark blue, black, and white AI startup theme.
- Use semantic HTML and accessible button, link, and form markup.
